info.title: Ditto Public API
info.description: Tenant-scoped API for device activation and usage. Authenticate with an API key created in the Ditto dashboard (Authorization: Bearer <key>). Each key carries scopes: `devices:trigger` to activate a device, `devices:pin` to manage pinned QR codes, `usage:read` to read usage.

put.summary: Set the device's pinned QR or switch its pin mode
put.description: Send `{url}` to pin a custom URL the device displays as a persistent QR while idle (1 credit per device whose effective URL actually changes; re-sending the identical URL is a free no-op), or `{mode: "none" | "inherit"}` to switch the device's pin mode (free — `inherit` follows the store/tenant pin, `none` suppresses any pin). Responses include `pinMode`, the resolved `effectiveUrl` (device > store > tenant precedence), `affectedDevices`, and `creditsCharged`. An optional Idempotency-Key header guards retried URL changes.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional key guarding a retried or concurrent URL change (ignored on free mode changes). Keys are scoped to this endpoint; reusing a key replays the prior response for the same URL-change request.

200.description: Pin state after the call: `{deviceId, pinMode, pin, effectiveUrl, affectedDevices, creditsCharged}`.

403.description: Missing devices:pin scope, or organization archived (URL changes only).

delete.summary: Reset the device's pin to inherit
delete.description: Free. Resets the device to `inherit` mode — the device falls back to the store/tenant pin, if any (it is NOT guaranteed blank; use PUT `{mode: "none"}` to suppress all pins). Idempotent.

200.description: Pin reset: `{deviceId, pinMode: "inherit", pin: null, effectiveUrl, affectedDevices, creditsCharged: 0}`.

post.description: Activates a device to show a QR code of a caller-supplied URL. Requires the `devices:trigger` scope and a unique `Idempotency-Key` header. Reserves 1 credit; the credit settles when the device acknowledges rendering, or is released on failure/expiry. Returns 202 with a queued command the device will poll for. Retrying with the same Idempotency-Key replays the original response without charging again.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: The device to activate. Must belong to the authenticated tenant.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key per logical request. Replaying the same key returns the original response and does not charge a second credit.

202.description: Command queued; the device will poll and render it.

put.summary: Set or replace the tenant-wide pinned QR
put.description: Pins a URL that every device resolving to the tenant level (device and store both in `inherit` mode) displays as a persistent QR. Costs 1 credit per device whose effective URL actually changes; re-sending the identical URL is a free no-op. The org level has no modes — send `{url}` only. An optional Idempotency-Key header guards retried changes.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional key guarding a retried or concurrent URL change. Keys are scoped to this endpoint; reusing a key replays the prior response for the same URL-change request.

200.description: Pin state after the call: `{pin: {url, pinnedAt}, affectedDevices, creditsCharged}`.

403.description: Missing devices:pin scope, or organization archived.

422.description: Invalid body or URL (`mode` is not supported at this scope).

delete.description: Free. Devices and stores in `inherit` mode fall back to no pin. Idempotent — deleting a non-existent pin succeeds.

put.summary: Set the store's pinned QR or switch its pin mode
put.description: Send `{url}` to pin a custom URL for the store's inheriting devices (1 credit per device whose effective URL actually changes; re-sending the identical URL is a free no-op), or `{mode: "none" | "inherit"}` to switch the store's pin mode (free — `inherit` follows the tenant pin, `none` suppresses any pin for this store's inheriting devices). An optional Idempotency-Key header guards retried URL changes.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional key guarding a retried or concurrent URL change (ignored on free mode changes). Keys are scoped to this endpoint; reusing a key replays the prior response for the same URL-change request.

200.description: Pin state after the call: `{storeId, pinMode, pin, affectedDevices, creditsCharged}`.

403.description: Missing devices:pin scope, or organization archived (URL changes only).

delete.summary: Reset the store's pin to inherit
delete.description: Free. Resets the store to `inherit` mode — its inheriting devices fall back to the tenant pin, if any. Idempotent.

200.description: Pin reset: `{storeId, pinMode: "inherit", pin: null, affectedDevices, creditsCharged: 0}`.

get.description: Credit-denominated usage for the authenticated tenant. Requires the `usage:read` scope.

action.description: The action to perform. Only `show_qr` is supported.

url.description: http(s) URL the device renders as a QR code. The caller hosts this content.
